messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Difficulties in specifying SAR (simultaneous autoregressive) process using rgeneric
parts:
Hi,
The correct way is to use log=TRUE in the densities. 
About your prior for rho: it will give mass only in (0.1192029, 0.5000000). 
best regards,
Elias

On Mon, 20 Jun 2022 at 23:51, lyh...@gmail.com <lyh...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi INLA groups,

I meet some difficulties in specificying SAR process-based random intercept models.

I am not sure whether the "log.prior" is well defined,

   res <- dgamma(param$prec, 5, 0.05, log = F) + theta[1L] +
      dunif(theta[2L], min = -0.5, max = 0.5, log = F)

so I assume theta1 follows gamma prior (5, 0.05) and theta2 follows unifom prior (-0.5, 0.5).

and I also assume that the spatial autocorrelation parameter (one of the hyperparameters) is within the bound (-1,1), so I reparameterized in this way.

 interpret.theta <- function() {
    return(
      list(prec = exp(theta[1L]),
           rho = 2 * exp(theta[2L])/(1 + exp(theta[2L])) - 1)
    )
  }

Is this correct?

I also copy the complete code here

'inla.rgeneric.SAR.model' <- function(
  cmd = c("graph", "Q", "mu", "initial", "log.norm.const",
          "log.prior", "quit"),
  theta = NULL) {
 
  #Internal function
  interpret.theta <- function() {
    return(
      list(prec = exp(theta[1L]),
           rho = 2 * exp(theta[2L])/(1 + exp(theta[2L])) - 1)
    )
  }
 
  graph <-  function(){
    return(Q())
  }
 
  Q <- function() {
    require(Matrix)
   
    param <- interpret.theta()
   
    return(param$prec * (Diagonal(nrow(W), x = 1) - param$rho * W) %*% t(Diagonal(nrow(W), x = 1) - param$rho * W))
  }
 
  mu <- function()
  {
    return(numeric(0))
  }
 
  log.norm.const <- function() {
    return(numeric(0))
   
  }
 
  log.prior <- function() {
    param = interpret.theta()
   
    res <- dgamma(param$prec, 5, 0.05, log = F) + theta[1L] +
      dunif(theta[2L], min = -0.5, max = 0.5, log = F)
   
     
    return(res)
  }
 
  initial <- function() {
    return(c(0, 0))
  }
 
  quit <- function() {
    return(invisible())
  }
 
  if (is.null(theta))
    theta <- initial()
 
  res <- do.call(match.arg(cmd), args = list())
  return(res)
}


Looking forward to hearing from you.
Best wish
